title: Prism Fund for LGBTQ+ Arizonans
status: Closed early: applications are no longer being accepted
closure_notice: Applications have closed early because available funds have been committed.
summary: Grants of $5,000 to $15,000 to organizations across Arizona that advance the health, safety, and belonging of LGBTQ+ people, with special attention to rural communities.
description: The Prism Fund was established in 2009 by LGBTQ+ donors and allies who wanted LGBTQ+ people in rural Arizona to have access to the same support available in the state's largest cities. Today the fund accepts applications from organizations statewide.

The fund supports both established LGBTQ+ organizations and mainstream organizations that are building programs to serve LGBTQ+ community members. Applications are reviewed by a committee of fundholders and community members.
impact_areas: Ending new HIV transmissions and supporting people living with HIV
Affirming physical, behavioral, and gender-affirming health care
Safe and supportive schools for LGBTQ+ students
Addressing discrimination in housing, employment, and public services
Reducing isolation among LGBTQ+ older adults and rural residents
populations_served: People living with or at risk of HIV

geography.summary: Applications are accepted from organizations serving communities anywhere in Arizona. Proposals serving rural counties receive additional consideration.

eligibility: Tax-exempt under Section 501(c)(3), a public agency, a federally recognized tribe or tribal program, or a project with a qualified fiscal sponsor
Has an anti-discrimination policy that includes sexual orientation and gender identity
One application per organization per year

how_to_apply.intro: The Prism Fund uses a single-stage application submitted through the CPCF Grant Portal.

steps.title: Read the guidelines
steps.text: Download the Prism Fund 2026–2027 Grant Guidelines.

steps.title: Prepare the application
steps.text: Use the Community Impact Grant Application Worksheet to draft responses. Prism applicants also answer two fund-specific questions listed in the guidelines.

steps.title: Submit online
steps.text: Submit the application and budget in the CPCF Grant Portal by 5:00 p.m. MST on November 20, 2026.

steps.title: Decision
steps.text: The Prism Fund committee reviews applications in December. Applicants are notified by January 15, 2027.

review_criteria: Leadership and involvement of LGBTQ+ people in the organization
Reach into rural or underserved communities

reporting.summary: Grantees submit a Community Impact Story Report at the end of the grant year.
items: A short narrative or photo story describing results
Permission for public sharing, with care for participant privacy and safety
